limitations: New time period was not used to tune model gates, but replay was run after implementation; future prospective validation remains necessary.
Recorded completion timestamps are not source arrival/poll timestamps; replay assumes immediate availability and does not test live delays.
This single approximately15-hour holdout has35 rare round events; it is too short for strong predictive claims.
Historical interval nonoverlap is a repeated conditional comparison, not a calibrated future edge or false-alert guarantee.
Model coverage depends on observed spacing and cannot prove complete provider delivery. Any-hit-window scores are not per-bet profits.
Zero issued backup alerts means backup precision, lift and Brier/log scores cannot be estimated.
